capabilities: Map Obsidian paths to ideashell folders
extras: Sync is one-way; edits made in ideashell do not flow back. The API key is the same one used for Claude/Cursor MCP clients.
problem: Manually transferring and keeping notes synchronized between Obsidian and the ideashell service is cumbersome and prone to duplication.
summary: A synchronization tool that sends Obsidian notes, folders, tags, and images to the external ideashell service, updating existing notes instead of duplicating them.
